description: Time-contracts by REMOVING wavecycles whose instantaneous frequency (1/cycle-length) is below freq (submode 1; submode 2 omits cycles ABOVE freq, submode 3 takes freq1 freq2 and keeps the band - same program via execute()). Removed cycles are cut out, not silenced, so output duration = the time the source spends above freq: verified almost exactly on a 220->880 Hz sweep (freq 440 keeps the last 1.3344 s of 2.0 - crossing at 0.667 s; freq 250 keeps 1.9054; freq 800 keeps 0.2567). The duration model 'static' is therefore an UPPER BOUND that is exact only when the whole file sits above freq (440 Hz tone at freq 300: 1.9977; flat noise at freq 440: 1.9999 - noise wavecycles are nearly all high-frequency). ZERO-OUTPUT TRAP: if every cycle is filtered out the program still EXITS 0, writing a 0-frame file (only symptom: 'WARNING: Can't close output sf-soundfile : can't truncate SFfile') - always check the output. Deterministic. MONO only.
musical_use: A time-domain 'frequency gate' that eats time instead of amplitude: on gliding or speech material it excises the low-pitched moments and butts the remainder together, creating rhythmic elisions you cannot get from a filter (the classic use: strip a sweep or vocal phrase to only its high moments, shortening it). On mixed material it acts as a crude pitch-selective decimator - freq just above the fundamental removes the pitched body and leaves transient/noise fizz. Time-varying freq (breakpoint) sweeps the cut boundary through the file. Use submode 2 (via execute) to keep lows instead, submode 3 for a band.

freq.description: Cycles with frequency below this are removed (CDP-enforced 10 Hz to Nyquist: 25000 refused 'out of range (10.000000 to 22050.000000)'; ceiling is input-dependent). Breakpoint-capable, banner-confirmed and verified (250->800 ramp on a sweep -> 1.8780 s, distinct from both endpoint renders 1.9054/0.2567). Setting it above all content -> 0-frame output with exit 0 (see known_issues).

skipcycles.description: Wavecycles to skip at the start. Scalar only: breakpoint refused 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 3 [frq.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'

examples.description: Keep only the upper half of a rising gesture.
examples.expected_use: Material below 440 Hz is excised and the rest closes ranks - on a 220-880 sweep this keeps the last two thirds. Duration shrinks by exactly the removed time.

examples.description: Sweep the elision boundary through the file.
examples.expected_use: Progressively hungrier low-cut: early material mostly survives, later material must be higher-pitched to remain.

known_issues: ZERO-OUTPUT TRAP (first-class): when all cycles fall below freq (e.g. a 440 Hz tone at freq 600, or unipolar material) the program EXITS 0 and leaves a 0-data-frame wav; stdout shows only 'WARNING: Can't close output sf-soundfile : can't truncate SFfile'. Flat noise with submode 2 at 440 does the same (noise cycles are nearly all >440 Hz). Verify frames on every render.

Duration model honesty: 'static' is an upper bound - real output duration = time the source spends above freq (sweep probes match crossing times within ~1%). The pinned row uses flat noise at freq 440 where static is exact (1.9999).
Submode 3 (band) does NOT swap inverted bounds: freq1 600 freq2 300 is accepted and produces the 0-frame trap output instead of the 300-600 band (no silent swap, unlike sfedit cut).
Stereo refused: 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (exit 255) -> mono.
